footprints.description: DDR1/DDR2 SODIMM socket, 200 contacts, 0.6 mm pitch, low profile, latch direct soldering (TE 1827236)

Pads 0.35 wide (printed 0.35+-0.03) x 2.0 long (2+-0.05); inner edge of each row 2.8 from the centre line (printed 2.8+-0.05), so row centres at +-(2.8+2.0/2) = +-3.8. Pin 1 pad centre = hole 1 + 1.75 (printed) + 0.35/2 = 1.925 from the 1.6 hole: x = -33.4+1.925 = -31.475; 33.4 = 66.8/2. The even row is shifted 0.3 along the row against the odd row: NOT printed on this sheet (measured 0.29 on an 8x enlargement; 0.3 = half the pitch, and printed as 2.05-1.75 on the sibling DDR3 sheet 2013297); used 0.3. hole 1.6 (pin 1 end, left) and hole 1.1 (right) on the pad-row centre line, 33.4 either side of the centre (66.8 printed between them). Solder/latch tabs: 3.9 along the row (printed 3.9+-0.03, 2 places) x 4.6 across (printed 4.6+-0.1), centre 12 from the row centre line (printed 12+-0.05) on the card side (y -12), along the row at hole + 0.55 inside: tab edge 2.5 from the 1.6 hole (printed), centre = 2.5-3.9/2 = 0.55; the other tab 61.8 further (printed): 2.5+61.8+3.9/2 = 66.25 from hole 1 = +32.85. Pad shift of the generator (gap key 0) = half the shift of the row against the centre: odd row centre +0.025, even row +0.325 (pad 1 at -31.475, pad 2 at -31.175). Housing: 71.1 max long (sheet 1 bottom dimension), 8.4 deep = 4.2+4.2 (sheet 1 stack about the centre line), assumed centred on the pad-row centre line.
